description: Compute 12*k times the classical Dedekind sum s(h,k) by Euclidean descent using Dedekind reciprocity.

source.title: Dedekind Sums: Archive of Formal Proofs entry
source.authors: Manuel Eberl, Anthony Bordg, Lawrence C. Paulson, Wenda Li
source.reference: Formalization of the classical sum definition and reciprocity law, following Apostol, Modular Functions and Dirichlet Series in Number Theory, Chapter 3.
source.implementation_status: Clean-room integer recurrence derived from the classical reciprocity identity.

output.mathematical_value: S=12*k*s(h,k), where s is the classical Dedekind sum
output.decode: S=result-29999700001; the rational sum is S/(12*k)

contract.dedekind_symbol: For real x, ((x))={x}-1/2 when x is not an integer, and 0 when x is an integer.
contract.algorithm: Apply the scaled reciprocity recurrence along Euclidean remainders until modulus 1, then unwind the saved values (or recurse) in reverse.
contract.bound_proof: Each sawtooth factor has absolute value at most 1/2 and there are k-1 terms, so |12*k*s(h,k)| <= 3*k*(k-1) <= 29999700000.
contract.invalid_cases: Null, malformed, out-of-range or noncanonical inputs, and non-coprime h,k return -1.

complexity.time: O(log k) Euclidean reciprocity steps for the primary; O(k) direct terms for the independent reference.
complexity.space: O(log k) recursion depth for the primary; O(1) additional space for the direct reference.
